what: MORPHEUSbot v13.1 gate (mock only). Numbers are read back from sim_live output, written files or source.

checks.name: source: lv_radar.h byte-identical to the v11-state tree (engine, camera law, place/clamp untouched)
source: lv_morpheus_v11.h and v12.h unchanged on disk (v11 = v11-state tree, v12 = the withdrawn v12 src copy); lv_inside_towers.h includes v13
source: drift tables + hooks verbatim from v12 (MO11_SX/Z0/RSSI/AX/WX/AZ/WZ/WH, mo11_drift, mo11_layout)
source: no select effect (no mo_brackets / mo_pill call, no flood) and no HACKbot neon literals
source: 3 folders with the DOWNLOAD drop timing (DROP0 300 ms, GAP 110, DROP 380)
idle motion: per-pillar MOTW read-back (X, Z, H, front/back corners, drift dx/dz/hk) + camera identical to v11 over the 600-frame idle recording
idle skin: v13 idle frames differ from v11 (new pillar skin)
idle camera keeps Gibson 0.5*sin(0.45 t) (max residual <= 0.0005)
touch: < TOWERS 70x39 (>= 36 px)
touch: every pillar keeps a tap cell in every idle sample (inherited v11 motion)
touch: >= 36 px idle tap cell for every pillar in every sample (inherited v11 motion; unchanged because positions must stay v11)
touch: each of the 12 pillars opens its device and < TOWERS closes it
close-up: every fully-open pillar is big on the LEFT (front face >= 50 px, centre 26..50, top 50..70; v13.1 deeper side face)
folders: all 3 folders landed at y 60/122/184 in every rendered open-state read-back (all12, 1.2 s and 3 s after each tap)
text: 0 clipped lines (every text line audited every rendered frame)

no red pill anywhere: 0 pill-ink pixels in every full frame, 0 red-blob pixels rows 24..319 (ticker rows 0..23 + locked BACKbot chip excluded: locked shared chrome), and no PILL string in any v13 text
motion: 0 frozen frames in the playthrough
crisp: close-up icon plate + icon uses <= 10 distinct colours (no blur / dither smear)
@3x stills are exact 3x nearest-neighbour of @1x
video: @3x 720x960 h264 yuv420p, every frame

failures: touch: every pillar keeps a tap cell in every idle sample (inherited v11 motion)
touch: >= 36 px idle tap cell for every pillar in every sample (inherited v11 motion; unchanged because positions must stay v11)
